$comment: Colors currently in use across lumora-academy and lumora-mobile, formalized here as the single reference — not a new brand palette. Values are Tailwind CSS v4's own default zinc/red/amber shades. lumora-academy consumes them for free via Tailwind utility classes (zinc-500, red-600, ...) with no redeclaration needed. lumora-mobile has no Tailwind, so its React Native StyleSheets reference the mirrored constants in lumora-mobile/src/constants/colors.ts, which must be kept in sync with this file by hand — see README.md for why there's no build pipeline doing that automatically yet.
